g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step into a first practice session, so interest
Nobody feels recruited or pressured · Organisers' hours stay as they are
Goal Tree (10) · Current Reality Tree (10) · Evaporating Cloud (5) · Future Reality Tree (17) ·
What stands in the way, and what comes first?
Organize a broad public invitation around deep, protected, practice-based pockets
A maturity-rated replication library distinguishes principles from local forms
Successful practices may remain tacit or spread as shallow copies
A pilot pocket or sangha container operates with outward-facing service
New values are hard to sustain without dense and supported containers
A graduated stewardship pathway with accountable role criteria exists
Delegating responsibility may reduce quality or create status hierarchy
A recurring, progressively deep practice architecture exists
Intellectual agreement does not reliably change daily practice
One transparent, consent-based entry pathway exists
New people lack a clear next step and may resist being funneled
A mixed-method throughput definition and review protocol are accepted
Throughput may be contested or become reductive before the goal model is
